title: hath0r.finops.token_telemetry_record/1
description: Schema for Hath0r Agent Token Telemetry Ingestion and FinOps Cost Records.

id.description: Unique identifier for the telemetry capture record (e.g. tok_...).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of token capture.

user_id.description: Identifier of the user or caller sending prompt to the agent.

prompt_length_chars.description: Character length of the prompt payload sent to the agent.

prompt_tokens.description: Number of input tokens consumed by the prompt.

completion_length_chars.description: Character length of agent output response.

completion_tokens.description: Number of output tokens generated by the agent.

cached.description: Whether the response was served from semantic cache.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata key-values associated with the capture.
